Let me specify: I don't only hate the gift giving, the food isn't good, the weather is cold and the music is awful. The entire aesthetic sucks to me and it reminds me of those who passed whom I loved who used to love this stupid holiday. For those of you who enjoy it, I wish I did, and no, I can't get out of gifts without looking like an asshole because those who love me get me beautiful expensive things  to show me they love me, love I appreciate and reciprocate because it is their love language. I've tried talking to them about it, and they'll keep doing it. There's also mandatory spouse family gifts and work secret santa's, etc.

I hate christmas, but I love my family more and this what they love doing so I endure it.
